summary: This resolution calls on the United States to prioritize inclusive artificial intelligence (AI) in its domestic and foreign policy by championing a regional AI strategy in the Americas, investing in AI development and education in the Western Hemisphere, and establishing common ethical frameworks and international cooperation to ensure AI systems promote social justice, economic well-being, and democratic values while combating biases.

scores.thoughts: The bill calls on the U.S. Government to leverage funding from economic and international development agencies to invest in AI research, education, training, and infrastructure throughout the Western Hemisphere. This directly relates to increasing foreign aid for AI development in the region.
